data.one_liner: Role-based access control and hierarchical permissions management system for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides type-safe permission and role management with inheritance, local caching, and custom storage support. Includes UI widgets like PermissionGuard, PermissionBuilder, and RoleSelector for conditional rendering.
use_when: You need role-based access control (RBAC) in your Flutter app.
You want hierarchical permissions and role inheritance.
You need to guard specific UI components or routes based on device permissions.
avoid_when: You need complex backend-driven user authentication and synchronization out of the box.
You are looking for hardware device permission management like camera or location permissions.
strengths: Supports both permission and role inheritance with cycle detection.
weaknesses: Completely rewritten in v3 with no automatic migration from v2.
Device-level roles by default; user-identity mapping requires custom storage implementation.
data.setup_notes: Initialize the package using PermissionPolicy.instance.initialize() and configure permissions and roles.
